cases.input: A run uses a 2024 regional grid factor and AR6 GWP100.
cases.expect: It pins the factor version and separate characterization-set version.
cases.violates: CO2e conversion pins both factor and characterization versions.

cases.input: The publisher replaces a factor after methodology correction.
cases.expect: A successor version preserves historical citations.
cases.violates: Corrections create successor versions and preserve cited history.

cases.input: A technology-specific factor is unavailable and a regional proxy is used.
cases.expect: The run records proxy substitution and representativeness downgrade.
cases.violates: Proxy substitution records a representativeness downgrade.

cases.input: A factor lacks denominator quantity kind and unit.
cases.expect: The factor is rejected as dimensionally unusable.
cases.violates: Numerator and denominator quantity kinds and units are explicit.

cases.input: A CO2e factor hides the GWP characterization release.
cases.expect: The result is rejected because characterization must be separately pinned.
cases.violates: GWP characterization set remains separately versioned.

cases.input: A corrected factor overwrites the cited 2023 version.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; successor lineage is required.
cases.violates: Corrections create successor versions and preserve cited history.

cases.input: Cloud spend is labelled measured emissions without an EEIO method.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected; spend is only an explicit proxy with uncertainty.
cases.violates: Financial cost never substitutes for an impact factor without an explicit spend-proxy method.

cases.input: A run cites factor registry R, factor set S, set version 2024.1, factor grid-regional-NL.
cases.expect: The factor resolves only through the pinned set version, and the set version is immutable after publication.
cases.violates: A factor version exists only inside one published factor set version.

cases.input: A factor version is identified by registry, factor and version alone, with no factor set version.
cases.expect: The factor version is rejected because set containment is part of its identity.
cases.violates: A factor version exists only inside one published factor set version.

cases.input: A new factor is added to published factor set version 2024.1.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; a successor set version is required.
cases.violates: A published factor set version never gains, loses or alters a factor version.

cases.input: Prior case gwp-embedded is migrated to fixture format v2.
cases.expect: The case carries id, target, kind, input, expect, violates, closesDefect null and an expectedCode, and its id is unchanged.
cases.violates: Every fixture carries id, target, kind, input, expect, violates and closesDefect, and every negative also carries expectedCode.

cases.input: A negative fixture asserts only that the artifact is rejected, with no expectedCode.
cases.expect: The fixture is rejected because a negative without a deterministic code cannot discriminate the cause of rejection.
cases.violates: Every fixture carries id, target, kind, input, expect, violates and closesDefect, and every negative also carries expectedCode.

cases.input: A factor version declares methodClass as other.
cases.expect: The factor version is rejected because methodClass is a closed set.
cases.violates: Every enumerated field is a closed set; an unrecognised value blocks the run rather than passing through.
